title: The tongue-tip hum: /n/
goal: Practise /n/ and use it in a short, understandable exchange.
cue: Touch the ridge behind your upper teeth with your tongue tip. Let your voice and air pass through your nose. For /m/ the lips close; for /n/ the tongue makes the closure.
spelling: n usually represents /n/. Keep the end of sun to one syllable.
task: Say your name and ask for the other person's name. Keep name to one syllable.

articulation.alt: pin: /p/ → /ɪ/ → /n/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /p/: Close the lips, then release the air.
/ɪ/: Front tongue, a little lower and relaxed.
